subject: Sinistrals
text: Gades, Amon, Erim, and Daos are fought one at a time during the prologue in the Fortress of Doom.

evidence.quote: You will fight these four, one at a time, during a prologue in the beginning.

subject: Sinistrals
text: Selan's Thunder spell is highly effective against all Sinistrals except Erim.

evidence.quote: Remember to make use of Selan's Thunder spell, which is highly effective against all the sinistrals except Erim.

subject: Erim
text: Erim is virtually immune to magic damage and may cast Mirror on herself, so magic should not be used against her.

evidence.quote: Erim might use Mirror on herself, but you shouldn't be casting magic on Erim anyway since she is virtually immune to magic damage.

subject: Gades
text: Gades only uses physical attacks, while the Mirror spell is very effective against the other three Sinistrals.

evidence.quote: Gades doesn't use magic - you only need to worry about physical attacks. The Mirror spell is very useful against the other three.

subject: Gades
text: The battle against Gades in Sheran is an unwinnable fight where he finishes the party in one blow.

evidence.quote: This is the only battle in the game that you're not supposed to win, so don't sweat it. He'll let you hit him a few times and then finish you off in one blow.

subject: Demon Lords
text: Talking to Aguro by the docks in Treck triggers a battle against four Demon Lords.

evidence.quote: After returning from the east cave, you will find two men by the docks. Use the inn and save your game before talking to Aguro; the green-haired person. Shortly after starting a conversation with Aguro, a group of monsters will arrive and you will have to fight them.

subject: Demon Lords
text: Aguro assists in the fight against the Demon Lords, and equipping the main character with the short sword found where Guy lives helps defeat them.

evidence.quote: The four Demon Lords are tough, but Aguro will lend a hand in the fight. Hopefully you've found the short sword where Guy lives and equipped it on the main character.

subject: Demon Lords
text: The Demon Lords know Mirror, Dew, and Strong.

evidence.quote: The Demon Lords know Mirror, Dew, and Strong.

subject: Goblins
text: Three Goblins attack the party when approaching the ship just outside of the Cave north of Treck.

evidence.quote: When you approach the ship just outside of the cave three Goblins will attack you, so make sure your party is at full HP.

subject: Goblins
text: Each Goblin has approximately 130 HP and relies solely on physical attacks that deal up to 20 HP per hit.

evidence.quote: The Goblins are pretty strong, with approximately 130 HP each. They will only use physical attacks, but they can take off up to 20 HP with each attack.

subject: Apprentice
text: The battle against the Apprentice in the Northwest Tower must be fought with only the main character.

evidence.quote: This is a difficult battle because it is fought with only your main character.

subject: Apprentice
text: The Apprentice has around 250 HP, high agility, and uses Jolt to inflict up to 30 points of damage.

evidence.quote: The Apprentice has around 250 HP and his attacks can do up to 30 points of damage to your character. He knows Jolt, which is a stronger version of his normal attack, and to make matters worse, his agility is really high.

subject: Apprentice
text: Mid arrows found behind the Apprentice's chamber are effective against him, and he uses potions when low on HP.

evidence.quote: If you really wanna pummel him, use the mid arrows found behind his chamber. He'll use potions when his HP is low.

subject: Phantasm
text: Equipping the Ghost Ring found in Ghost Cave on Aguro increases damage against the Phantasm.

evidence.quote: Stock up on a few shrieks before going into the Ghost Cave. Also, before this fight make sure the Ghost Ring found in the cave is equipped on either Aguro or your character.

subject: Phantasm
text: The Phantasm can confuse characters, which can be cured using a shriek or by having Lufia attack them.

evidence.quote: The only thing that makes this battle potentially dangerous is the Phantasm's ability to confuse your characters. If a character becomes confused, use a shriek or attack the character with Lufia.

subject: Follower
text: Equipping Lufia with the Flash Ring found in North Tower makes the battle against Follower significantly easier.

evidence.quote: Equip the Flash Ring, found in the tower, on Lufia before the fight.

subject: Follower
text: Casting Bolt or Flash repeatedly with Lufia is the primary method to damage the Follower.

evidence.quote: Continually cast Bolt on the Follower while the other two attack. If you haven't learned Bolt yet, then Flash will suffice.

subject: Follower
text: The Follower uses Frost and Drowsy, which can be countered with Stronger and Lufia's Awaken spell.

evidence.quote: The Follower's Frost magic can do some fast damage to your characters, so have your main character or Lufia (whoever's doing less damage) ready with the Stronger spell. Drowsy will also be occasionally cast, but Lufia should know the spell Awaken by now.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: The Ghost Ring is ineffective against Dark Ghost, whose Water spell can inflict roughly 40 points of damage.

evidence.quote: For some reason, the Ghost Ring is ineffective for this battle, so don't equip it. The Dark Ghost's Water spell can do around 40 points of damage to your characters, so you might want to use Magic Guards, Shield or Protect if you know it.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: Dark Ghost uses Ectoplasm to drain most of a character's MP, while Lufia's Bolt and Flash Ring combination deals major damage to him.

evidence.quote: He also has something called Ectoplasm that, if hits, will drain a most of the MP from one of your characters. Use our favourite Bolt + Flash Ring combo to take huge chunks out of the Dark Ghost's HP (makes the battle a whole lot easier!) but don't forget about the importance of healing.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: Dark Ghost is vulnerable to fire magic and all party members should be at least level 20 for the fight.

evidence.quote: The Dark Ghost is vulnerable to fire magic, so Jerin casting Flame or Spark with the Flame Ring may be a good idea, but I was healing so much with her that I never did this. The important thing here is to keep healing as much as possible. All your characters should be at least level 20.

subject: Guardian
text: The Guardian frequently casts Absorb, uses Dread, and can be countered using Mirror and Protect against Flame or Blizzard.

evidence.quote: Use Mirror a lot if you know it, and maybe Lufia's Protect if his Flame or Blizzard spells are bothering you. He likes to cast Absorb a lot. Oh, and I saw him use Dread once.

subject: Aisen Tower switch puzzle
object: Upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right
text: The switch puzzle order to open the door in Aisen Tower without triggering the Pirates is upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right.

evidence.quote: These are the four guys who'll attack you if you mess up the order on the switches in front of the door. The best idea is simply to avoid them by opening the door on the first attempt. The order is upper left, lower right, lower left, upper right.

subject: Bosun
text: Bosun has around 1250 HP and should be killed first before attacking Pirates.

evidence.quote: Kill Bosun (the small guy) first - don't worry about Pirates until Bosun is defeated. Bosun has around 1250 HP.

subject: Pirates
text: Bosun and Pirates use items and Dubious, while Pirates casts Roar and Foul to confuse and inflict fright on characters.

evidence.quote: Both of these guys love to use a lot of items, such as bombs and various types of arrows. Bosun likes to use a lot of potions. They also know Dubious, which raises their stats. The only magic you need to worry about is Roar and Foul, both cast by Pirates.

subject: Boost
text: Jerin learns the Boost spell at level 32.

evidence.quote: Jerin should use Boost whenever any of your characters have taken considerable damage. Her Boost spell is learned at level 32.

subject: Oil Dragon
text: The Oil Dragon deals heavy fire damage, making it necessary to cast Mirror starting with the character having the lowest MGR.

evidence.quote: He has a high amount of HP, and his fire attacks can do some heavy damage to your characters. Cast Mirror on all the characters, starting with whomever has the lowest MGR.

subject: Thunder
text: Thunder is learned at level 41, but players must beware that Oil Dragon can cast Mirror against Lufia's Bolt or Thunder spells.

evidence.quote: The Oil Dragon can cast Mirror, so remember that while you use Lufia's Flash Ring + Bolt/Thunder. Thunder is learned at level 41. Besides Mirror, Jerin should also be using Boost or Valor a lot.

subject: Oil Dragon
text: The Dragon Ring is ineffective against the Oil Dragon, but Jerin can cast Glacier when party HP and Mirror reflect buffs are secure.

evidence.quote: The Dragon Ring (found in the Oil Cave) doesn't seem to have an effect in this fight for some reason, so don't bother with it. If all your characters have a high HP, most of them have Mirror, and you're looking for something to do with Jerin, cast Glacier on the Oil Dragon.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby has 5600 HP, and Lufia must be equipped with the Flash Ring at the top of Glasdar Tower before fighting him.

evidence.quote: This dude has 5600 HP, so be prepared for a long battle. Make absolutely certain you equip Lufia with the Flash Ring before the fight.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby casts first-tier spells initially, advances to Flame, Blizzard, and Water after damage, and uses Vulcan, Flood, Glacier, and Succumb late in the battle.

evidence.quote: Nazeby knows virtually every attack spell there is. He'll cast spells such as Blast, Spark, Frost, Bolt, and Dew at the beginning of the battle, switch to second level spells such as Flame, Blizzard, and Water after taking a bit of damage, and move up to stronger spells such as Vulcan, Flood, Glacier, and Succumb after taking a lot of damage.

subject: Nazeby
text: Nazeby has an attack called Mace that instantly kills a party member if successful.

evidence.quote: He also has an attack called Mace that, if successful, kills one of your characters instantly.

subject: Nazeby
text: Rally revives and restores full HP, while Jerin should continually cast Mirror on everyone throughout the Nazeby battle.

evidence.quote: Jerin and your main character should've learned Rally by now, a spell that revives like Dead but restores all HP at the same time. Jerin should be using Mirror on everybody, and continually casting it during the fight.

subject: Nazeby
text: If Nazeby casts Mirror, Lufia should switch to healing or using power gourds on physical attackers until the reflect barrier fades.

evidence.quote: By the way, Nazeby has been known to cast Mirror - albeit rather infrequently. If he uses it, have Lufia either heal or use power gourds on your attackers until it fades.
